literal_meaning: লম্বা কোঁচা চুল (long locks of hair)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার লম্বাকোঁচা দেখে বোঝা যায় সে ধনী পরিবারের।
example_sentences_in_english: His long locks indicate he comes from a wealthy family.
In the village, long locks are a sign of prosperity.
history: Refers to the traditional hairstyle of affluent Bengali men in rural or semi-urban settings, where long, oiled hair was a luxury indicator.
note: Often used to describe people from prosperous backgrounds in colloquial Bengali.
